To help fix a problem, this shares:

• a diagnostic log (stops, lines, and errors the app saw)
• a screenshot of this screen
• your exact location for the past 15 minutes
• how far you are from each nearby stop

On Continue, the report is copied to your clipboard and offered to an app you pick.
